column1: # Test vector for the Chuvadi.Pdf FontFace cmap bug found by the Chuvadi.OpenType oracle (2026-11-05).
# Pack fonts (cleanroom-shaping-pack, fonts/). For each line, FontFace.GetGlyph(code point) in
# Chuvadi.Pdf.Fonts.Rendering 3.26.0 returns 0; the expected glyph is the one in the font's format 12
# subtables (3,10) and (0,4), which agree. The font's format 4 subtables cannot hold these code points.
